newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Death toll from influenza hits 15 in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Death toll from influenza hits 15 in Russia.

text.p: Fifteen people have died in an influenza epidemic sweeping Russia, a health ministry official said on Wednesday.

Seven people had died in the Moscow region, five in the southern city of Volgograd, two in the Urals city of Perm and one in the central region of Ivanovo, said the official at the ministry's department for sanitary and epidemic control.
She told Reuters the illness had reached epidemic proportions in 30 cities, including Moscow and St Petersburg, but had not yet reached its peak.
